rationale: The two-voter probe that bounds the configuration-recovery account - the node with no tracked configuration still votes, so its peer is elected while it never becomes a candidate - has been executed once, while every other case in that account and in the replay account has at least two executions. This repeat tests whether the split comes back the same from the retained inputs: the peer reaching Leader in a two-voter group (which requires the defective node's vote) and zero candidate samples for the defective node in the sampling window.
